subcommands.name: create-event-source-mapping
subcommands.description: Creates a mapping between an event source and an Lambda function.

options.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the event source.

options.name: --function-name
options.description: The name or ARN of the Lambda function.

options.name: --enabled
options.description: When true, the event source mapping is active.

options.name: --no-enabled
options.description: When true, the event source mapping is active.

options.name: --batch-size
options.description: The maximum number of records in each batch that Lambda pulls from your stream or queue and sends to your function.

options.name: --filter-criteria
options.description: An object that defines the filter criteria that determine whether Lambda should process an event.

options.name: --maximum-batching-window-in-seconds
options.description: The maximum amount of time, in seconds, that Lambda spends gathering records before invoking the function.

options.name: --parallelization-factor
options.description: (Kinesis and DynamoDB Streams only) The number of batches to process from each shard concurrently

options.description: The position in a stream from which to start reading.

options.description: With StartingPosition set to AT_TIMESTAMP, the time from which to start reading.

options.name: --destination-config
options.description: (Kinesis, DynamoDB Streams, Amazon MSK, and self-managed Kafka only) A configuration object that specifies the destination of an event after Lambda processes it

options.name: --maximum-record-age-in-seconds
options.description: (Kinesis and DynamoDB Streams only) Discard records older than the specified age.

options.name: --bisect-batch-on-function-error
options.description: (Kinesis and DynamoDB Streams only) If the function returns an error, split the batch in two and retry

options.name: --no-bisect-batch-on-function-error
options.description: (Kinesis and DynamoDB Streams only) If the function returns an error, split the batch in two and retry

options.name: --maximum-retry-attempts
options.description: (Kinesis and DynamoDB Streams only) Discard records after the specified number of retries.

options.name: --tags
options.description: A list of tags to apply to the event source mapping

options.name: --tumbling-window-in-seconds
options.description: (Kinesis and DynamoDB Streams only) The duration in seconds of a processing window for DynamoDB and Kinesis Streams event sources.

options.name: --queues

options.name: --source-access-configurations

options.name: --self-managed-event-source
options.description: The self-managed Apache Kafka cluster to receive records from

options.name: --function-response-types
options.description: (Kinesis, DynamoDB Streams, and Amazon SQS) A list of current response type enums applied to the event source mapping
